Record Class Pages2kClimateProvider.TemperatureAnomalyRecord

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.ether.society.data.Pages2kClimateProvider.TemperatureAnomalyRecord
Record Components:
yearCe - year Common Era (1 to 2000 CE)
medianAnomalyC - full ensemble median temperature anomaly (\(^\circ\text{C}\))
percentile2_5C - ensemble 2.5th percentile lower bound (\(^\circ\text{C}\))
percentile97_5C - ensemble 97.5th percentile upper bound (\(^\circ\text{C}\))
filtered31yrMedianC - 31-year Butterworth filtered median anomaly (\(^\circ\text{C}\)), or NaN if unavailable
Enclosing class:
Pages2kClimateProvider
public static record Pages2kClimateProvider.TemperatureAnomalyRecord(int yearCe, double medianAnomalyC, double percentile2_5C, double percentile97_5C, double filtered31yrMedianC) extends Record
Immutable record representing a single year's global temperature reconstruction anomaly.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.

      Parameters:
